metrics.reservation_sampling: KNOWN waiting-gate attempts, not uniform scheduler steps; committed includes R/I, growth excludes them
metrics.semantics: Linear-interpolated quantiles as B metrics; all arrived requests retained. Gaps exclude TTFT. Incomplete gaps are lower bounds; one-token completed requests have vacuous zero gap. Host receipt and host completion observations, not device completion.

recovery_chains.semantics: Single-process host perf_counter clock. Demand starts at observed preemption return, not unobserved allocation pressure. GPU allocation precedes LOAD submission; ACK may lead to a second allocation boundary. Job completion is host notification, not GPU finish. Missing ACK/reentry timestamps in older traces remain null. Aggregate durations overlap subintervals and must not be summed with them. Repeated preemptions bound separate episodes.

mc_load_activity.semantics: New WAITING first-admission LOAD only. Full prompt charged at h=0; delayed target growth is bounded by the original earliest-growth envelope. All original old-owner guards, native fit, peak calculation, accounting and FIFO remain. This is a runtime adaptation of existing MC, not a new scheduling method.

semantics: One run per setting; no confidence intervals or additive attribution. No recovery protection disables both the recovery gate (Hr=0) and lease victim selection. No admission retains recovery protection. MC LOAD is a separate component baseline. Ha=64 is the event-rich development setting; it is not the F3 selected Ha=256.
